title: Audience of the Sun
description: The Umvuthi of the designated Grove will not receive an unrecognized intruder. Approach beneath an Umvuthana mask and claim a legitimate audience with the Grove's living creator-god.
description_completed: The designated Umvuthi has received the Overlord in formal audience. The Grove is now neutral unless the Overlord gives it cause to become hostile again.

dialogue.offer: You enter beneath the faces of my children, ruler of the dark tower. The mask grants you audience. Speak, and let this Grove learn what has returned to the world.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: I have heard your claim. My children will not strike at your shadow merely for crossing our Grove. Do not mistake restraint for surrender.
dialogue.completed: The Grove remembers this audience. So long as you remember its terms, you may stand before me without hiding behind another face.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record formal audience with the designated Umvuthi
Establish neutrality with the designated Grove
